tools.name: wa_tax_on
tools.description: Sales tax and total for an amount at a Washington address, at DOR's rate for that address and quarter. Takes the amount as taxable; it does not decide taxability. Privacy: addresses are sent to the Washington State Department of Revenue (DOR) to look up the rate. Search Upside doesn't store anything
